AUTHOR: Maeda
TITLE: A Novel Application of Deep Learning-Based Estimation of Fish Abundance and Temporal Patterns in Agricultural Drainage Canals for Sustainable Ecosystem Monitoring
REGION: Agricultural drainage canal fish refuge, Miho Village, Ibaraki Prefecture, Japan
DATA: Own time-lapse camera images, 4 survey days (Apr/Jul/Sep 2024, Mar 2025); 675 annotated images; 12,600-image inference set (22 Jul 2024)
V_EV: Sec. 3.3: 'the underwater images were generally turbid and only captured clear outlines when the fish were close to the camera'; Sec. 2.2: 'water depth at the study site was 0.44 m'
D2: Train/val 546/129 images (~4:1) mainly from 3 other days + 2% of inference-day images; test = 300 random images from the 12,600-image inference day
D_EV: Sec. 2.3: 'we intentionally included an additional 2.0% of the images from the inference dataset... This inclusion created a small overlap between the training and inference datasets (approximately 2%)'
R_EV: Sec. 2.5: 'we randomly sampled 300 images from 12,600-image inference dataset' - same site and campaign, inference day partly included in training.
C_EV: Sec. 3.1: 'the F1 score for both target species peaked at a confidence threshold of 0.427'; Sec. 2.6: correction for 'multiple detections of the same individual across consecutive frames' (Rframes)
E_EV: Sec. 3.3: 'it was estimated that approximately 7300 individual P. parva passed through the field of view between 6:00:00 and 12:59:58' - no comparison with independent or manual counts
METR: Precision, recall, F1, mAP50, mAP50-95, confusion matrix
NOTE: Training data mostly from other survey days but deliberately includes ~2% of the inference-day images, so the test day is not cleanly held out; coded image-level with leakage discussed (D4=Y). Authors call the 300-image check 'external validation' but it is same site/campaign with overlap; test day (July) is a different season from training days, but contamination -> R1=N (low confidence; a verifier might code R1=Y/계절, R3=Y since val vs inference metrics are both given: F1 91.6 vs 61.6). V: image acquisition limited to daytime 'to ensure sufficient visibility' - P1 might be argued (V_ALL=N), but turbid footage was retained and described. Rframes (2.5, 5) set empirically for duplicate counting; threshold sensitivity analysis (Fig. 6-7). FN count (190) and recall used for correction.
